purpose: Primary literature for additional ventricular CM segregation axes; factual gene examples, not ready-made validated signatures.

papers.title: Cells of the adult human heart
papers.source_access: Verified fulltext XML and article metadata
papers.model: 14 adult human hearts; atria, LV/RV free walls, apex, septum; sc/snRNA-seq and smFISH

axes.evidence: vCM2 comprised39.9% of RV CMs vs9.1% of LV; vCM1 comprised63.9% of LV vs36.7% of RV. PRELID2 enrichment verified by smFISH. Authors emphasize small LV/RV program differences.
axes.limitations: An adult human reference, not a validated mouse P0/P7/P14/P21 chamber classifier. These genes alone do not establish ventricular side.

axes.evidence: Small vCM5 population (~1%); authors say may participate in electrophysiology.
axes.limitations: Not verified Purkinje cells; primary authors frame this as a hypothesis. Nuclear capture/neuronal contamination and developmental expression must be checked.

axes.evidence: vCM4 enriched nuclear mitochondrial and cytoprotective/sarcomeric genes.
axes.limitations: Not measured oxygen availability or respiration; overlaps prior metabolic analysis.

short_quotes: differences between vCM1 and vCM2 are small

papers.title: Single-Cell Resolution of Temporal Gene Expression during Heart Development
papers.source_access: Verified abstract and fulltext NCBI BioC XML; EuropePMC fullTextXML returned500
papers.model: >1,200 mouse cells at7 stages E9.5–P21; chambers isolated; protein validation atP0/P3

axes.evidence: CME+ cells coexpress sarcomeric and ECM programs; isolated P3 LV CMs with Tnni3 and Col3a1 protein show47% Col3a1 positivity, versus36% in RNA data. Organized sarcomeres and comparable cell size supported CM identity.
axes.limitations: Do not call fibrosis or fibroblast conversion. In new snRNA-seq, ambient RNA/doublets and CM identity require explicit checks; single collagen gene insufficient.

axes.evidence: Article describes continuous overlapping developmental waves fromE9.5 toP21, with sarcomeric, fatty-acid oxidation and calcium-handling changes.
axes.limitations: These are illustrative observed genes, not an independently validated fixed maturity-score signature. Myl7 is not by itself atrial identity in immature ventricular cells.

axes.axis: Embryonic chamber programs and their convergence
axes.evidence: LV/RV differential genes atE11.5; transcriptomes become more similar betweenE14.5 andP0.
axes.limitations: Strong caution for using embryonic LV/RV markers in postnatal cells; Hand2/Isl1 fate is not established by expression alone.

short_quotes: This CM subpopulation expressed transcripts encoding extracellular matrix (ECM) proteins
Between E14.5 and P0, LV and RV CMs became transcriptionally more similar to one another

papers.title: Frequency of mononuclear diploid cardiomyocytes underlies natural variation in heart regeneration
papers.source_access: Verified abstract and fulltext BioC XML
papers.model: 120 inbred mouse strains, Tnni3k knockout, adult injury; zebrafish overexpression

axes.evidence: Adult mononuclear CM frequency varied>7-fold; Tnni3k influences MN-diploid content and proliferation after injury.
axes.limitations: Tnni3k RNA is not a ploidy classifier. A nucleus can come from mono- or binucleated cells. DNA content and intact-cell nuclear counts are required; cycling RNA cannot prove cytokinesis.

short_quotes: the frequency of adult mononuclear cardiomyocytes was surprisingly variable (>7-fold)

papers.title: The cardiomyocyte molecular clock regulates the circadian expression of Kcnh2 and contributes to ventricular repolarization
papers.source_access: Verified abstract and fulltext BioC XML
papers.model: Adult mouse inducible CM-specific Bmal1 deletion, qPCR, voltage clamp, reporter assays, ECG;14–16-week collection cohorts

axes.evidence: Kcnh2 has robust circadian expression disrupted by CM-specific Bmal1 deletion; recorded IKr approximately50% smaller in deletion CMs; QT rhythm altered. Core clock factors defined in fulltext.
axes.limitations: Clock phase is a dynamic state/confound, not necessarily a stable subtype. Requires harvest-time metadata, coherent positive/negative limb patterns and age-aware assessment. Neonatal clock maturation may differ from adult model. Bmal1 alias should map to Arntl.

short_quotes: only Kcnh2 exhibited a robust circadian pattern of expression

papers.title: Transcriptomic Profiling Maps Anatomically Patterned Subpopulations among Single Embryonic Cardiac Cells
papers.source_access: Verified abstract and fulltext BioC XML
papers.model: 2,233 embryonic mouse cells E8.5/E9.5/E10.5; anatomical dissections and Isl1-lineage tracing

axes.evidence: ATLAS-seq500-gene spatial classifier reconstructed embryonic zone with>91% accuracy and confirmed Isl1-lineage descendants mostly inOFT/RV.
axes.limitations: Do not transfer embryo-trained500-gene classifier unvalidated toP0/P7/P14/P21 nuclei. Isl1 RNA absence does not exclude Isl1-lineage ancestry; lineage tracing, not current expression, establishes origin.

short_quotes: predicted the second heart field distribution of Isl1-lineage descendants
